For every n>=6 the complete facets are n square tetrahedra Q_i={i,i+1,i+n,i+n+1}, 2n skew tetrahedra P_i={i,i+1,i+2,i+n+1}, full f=(2n,7n,8n,3n). Four explicit elementary free-face phases have 2n,n,2n,n pairs; the exact remaining 2n triangles form a triangulated one-boundary Möbius strip with f=(2n,4n,2n), Euler zero and path vertex links, so homotopy S¹. The rim is the boundary of a Möbius band and winds twice its core, while the n square-cell boundaries generate free H1 kernel of rank n; the quotient is Z and hence their n independent relations are a free basis. n=3,4 graph diameter two, so complex simplex. n=5 exact f=(10,35,50,25,2) admits a free-face collapse to a closed connected 2-sphere triangulation; independently a different 48-pair greedy collapse reduced it to six-vertex octahedral S² with f=(6,12,8). Independently reconstructed every facet and replayed all 6n free faces for n=6..9. These finite tests support but do not replace local residue and free-face proof for every n>=6.
